status: Exploratory; decisions recorded before these follow-up outcomes, after prior ERP results; no preregistration claim

models.selection: minimum validation MSE per seed; equal mean of three seed predictions for ERP deployment; no ERP tuning
models.adaptations: Architecture translated from TensorFlow to PyTorch; identical layer order, padding, BN epsilon/momentum and flatten ordering. Conventional minibatch BN/dropout training rather than original per-example calls; source-isolated existing 60/20/20 fixed mixtures at four SNRs; architecture reproduction, not original published training results.

reference_recipe.filter: fourth-order forward-backward Butterworth within original recording boundaries; 30-Hz lowpass after construction for matched ERP analysis
reference_recipe.ica: per-recording extended infomax, 29 components, systematic every-fourth-sample fit; ICLabel features on the entire 256-Hz stream; max_iter=500, seed=94709+subject

policies.brain_argmax: keep only ICs whose most probable class is brain
policies.artifact80: remove ICs with probability >=0.8 in eye, muscle, heart, line or channel noise; retain other/uncertain

reference_recipe.unreported_original_choices: Benchmark publication does not specify filter design/order, ICA settings, component thresholds or manual-selection decisions. This is an automated instantiation and sensitivity analysis, not an exact recreation of original labels. No manual selection or epoch rejection.
reference_recipe.control: apply same classified ICA to 0.1-30-Hz parent to isolate component selection from reference bandpass
reference_recipe.execution_amendment: Before any recipe result was obtained, ICA fitting was changed to every fourth sample for tractable computation on all 80 records. This subsamples time points for spatial fitting; no downsampled series enters ICLabel PSD/autocorrelation. All events/voltages remain at 256 Hz.

coverage_diagnostics.scope: conditional on frozen procedures; original fit remains primary; separate refits diagnose instability, not restore confirmatory guarantees

scope: Parent-relative endpoint preservation and controlled digital response, not cortical purity or universal causality of benchmark-model failures.

target_intervention.learner: full temporal affine ridge, 512 inputs + intercept, shared design/regularization, three separately optimized target definitions
target_intervention.source_selection: parent epochs and recipe targets from identical ERP development trials, all30 channels; fixed half-epoch split within each development person for fit/validation; public EOG train/validation source pools strictly separated
target_intervention.evaluation: unchanged ten evaluation people, parent input without added synthetic artifact, plus matched synthetic-contamination control; common frozen decoder
target_intervention.interpretation: Changing only target construction while fixing training inputs and learner isolates a target-definition effect on fitted digital outputs; parent is not known pure neural voltage. Artificial EOG mixing remains a controlled training device, not validation of physiological purity.
